newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta shares show modest gains on funds support.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta shares show modest gains on funds support.

text.p: Calcutta share prices on Monday recorded small gains on modest support from foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
They said smart gains posted by blue-chips in early deals were minimised by profit-taking at the close.

"The renewed buying interest in shares of medium cap firms is a good sign. Blue-chips also moved up but profit-taking at higher levels erased the gains," said Aprajit Sharma of brokers Jet Age Securities.
Dealers said shares of ACC, TISCO and ITC were actively traded and figured in the list of major gainers at the start of the session.
